attempts.cause: The new focused test initially omitted the repository-standard src path bootstrap.
attempts.correction: Added the same bounded sys.path bootstrap used by existing tests; all six focused tests and all 68 repository tests pass.

attempts.result: URLError getaddrinfo failed before a wheel was acquired
attempts.cause: The first wrapper attempted credential-free acquisition while DNS resolution was unavailable.
attempts.correction: The evaluator reused retained exact source-gated wheel custody only after rechecking all six SHA-256 hashes, copied those bytes into disposable evaluation custody, passed 2 schemas and 26 fixtures offline, and removed the disposable copy.

attempts.cause: The read-only wrapper passed requirements/*.json directly to rg on Windows.
attempts.correction: The corrected directory-scoped search completed without writes.

attempts.result: PowerShell raised a native-command error while unittest emitted normal progress output to stderr, before the wrapper evaluated Python's exit code.
attempts.cause: The first concise replay inherited terminating error handling for native stderr.
attempts.correction: The corrected wrapper captured native stderr non-terminatingly, checked the actual process exit, and passed all 68 tests plus every contract and implementation validator and mutation suite.

attempts.result: The CLI returned IS_USAGE at exit 64.
attempts.cause: The inspection invoked --help, which is not part of the frozen v1 machine command grammar.
attempts.correction: Read the existing command contract and invoked the supported policy status JSON command.

attempts.result: PowerShell parsed part of the rg expression as a command before the search executed.
attempts.cause: The first search used an unsafe double-quoted alternation containing escaped quotes.
attempts.correction: The corrected search used a literal single-quoted expression and completed without writes.

attempts.result: The CLI returned IS_MANIFEST_READ at exit 74.
attempts.cause: The first status invocation omitted the contracts directory from the fixture path.
attempts.correction: The supported command with fixtures/contracts/workflow.valid.minimal.json returned approval MISSING, verification INVALID, and exit 12 without writing approval or starting runtime.

decision.reason: These evaluator and wrapper attempts are not product evidence. Their corrected paths pass without erasing the INVALID history.
decision.next: Use only the corrected src bootstrap, offline hash-verified schema evaluator, and directory-scoped search path.
